title: 章八 检测
slug: 罪恶之城全本免费-罪恶之城最新章节列表
content_zh:
为了物资流通，依山面海的深蓝自带一个深水港口，十几个能够停泊巨型远洋海轮的泊位都是用魔法在坚硬的礁岩中生生开辟出来的。在陆地上，三条主要的公路从三个方向联接着深蓝，公路沿线至少有五六个城镇因为往来贸易而繁荣。
深蓝位于大陆西北部浮冰海湾的顶点，同时也是两条大河的入海口。浮冰海湾面积广大，完全就是大海，从南端的星辉半岛至北线的恒冬山脉直线距离超过一千五百公里。每到冬季，浮冰海湾就会进入封冻期，只有最南部的海岸线一带可以通航。而深蓝的港口位于暖流的终点，属于不冻港。
深蓝所处的位置十分重要，这里交通便利，又扼守住了冰洋大陆南下的三条主要通道之一，凶猛的极地灰矮人和魔兽只能选择绕行东方的日落峡谷，那条道路要多绕上一千多公里不说，而且需要直接面对神圣同盟帝国的雷神要塞。不过深蓝建成之后的几场大战让极地灰矮人宁可去冲击雷神要塞，也不愿意再尝试苏海伦的手段。这个女人在极地灰矮人许多部落的传说中已经和最恐怖的邪神并列。而当她正式突破20级的大关，晋级传奇法师之后，深蓝就彻底变成了一片和平的土地。
即使以凶狠残暴、战力强悍著称的灰矮人也不愿意再破坏这里的和平。于是渐渐的，深蓝周围变成了一片美丽繁荣的土地。
以上就是深蓝的历史。
这段历史的讲述者是一位近百岁的老法师，他的魔力并不高强，八级的水准几乎是李察在深蓝中见到的最肉货色。但是老法师卖相极佳，声音抑扬顿挫，对于深蓝的历史精通程度仅次于苏海伦。他的职责很简单，就是为来到深蓝的来访者讲解历史。而对于李察这样的新学徒来说，学习深蓝光辉而荣耀的过去即是他魔法生涯的第一课，其重要程度甚至超过了魔力和天赋检测。后者决定了一个魔法师在复杂的魔法世界中哪条道路上能够走得更远，而前者，李察很久之后才明白，却是决定了某个魔法学徒能不能走上魔法这条路。
李察的地位和其它魔法学徒不同，他是苏海伦亲自招收的弟子，所以普通学徒一天的历史学习，生生变成了三天。想要把深蓝的历史讲上三天，的确也是很考验老法师水准的。
老法师口中的历史里面自然遗漏了许多细节，还刻意的忽略了很多关键性的东西。不过官撰的历史总是会有所取舍，什么能说，什么只能遗忘，都是学问。能够在脑海中自行拼凑出一幅相当完整的画卷，李察已经是把智慧和真实的天赋彻底发挥出来了。
三天的洗脑还是有着显著的作用。至少现在李察再看到苏海伦时，绝对不会把她当成天真无邪的白嫩少女了，更没有咬上一口的冲动。连灰矮人和冰洋巨兽都畏惧的女人，怎么形容其恐怖都不为过。
当然，这个结果肯定不是老法师的初衷，但他也不会知道。在大多数人眼里，李察是个安静的孩子，安静到很少有多余的表情，没见过他高兴地笑，也不曾见他被训斥或被欺负后哭，让他做什么就会立刻去做，而且完成得一丝不苟，精确得无可挑剔，完全不象一个才十岁的孩子。
在李察身上，完全没有阳光。
三天的历史课过去，就是接下来的魔力天赋检测。李察被带入一个特殊的大厅，林立的炼金器具看得他眼花缭乱。而大厅中忙忙碌碌的法师足有二十多个，主持检测的更是一个大魔法师，李察运用‘真实’能力时，看到的根本不是一个魔法师，而是一团燃烧着的魔力火球！这是一个至少十七级的大魔法师，能够在任何帝国担任宫庭法师了，却被指派来作他的天赋检测。

content_en:
For the purpose of material circulation, Deep Blue, which is surrounded by mountains and faces the sea, has its own deep-water port. More than a dozen berths capable of berthing giant ocean-going ships were carved out of the hard rocks using magic. On land, three main highways connect Deep Blue from three directions. There are at least five or six towns along the highways that prosper due to trade.
Deep Blue is located at the top of the floating ice bay in the northwest of the continent and is also the mouth of two large rivers. The floating ice bay is vast and is completely the sea. The straight-line distance from the Xinghui Peninsula in the south to the Hengdong Mountains in the north exceeds 1,500 kilometers. Every winter, the floating ice bay enters the freezing period, and only the southernmost coastline is navigable. The dark blue port is located at the end of the warm current and is an ice-free port.
The location of Deep Blue is very important. It has convenient transportation and holds one of the three main passages southward from the Ice Ocean Continent. The ferocious polar gray dwarves and Warcraft can only choose to go around the Sunset Canyon in the east. That road is more than a thousand kilometers long and needs to directly face the Thunder God Fortress of the Holy Alliance Empire. However, several battles after Deep Blue was built made the polar gray dwarves rather attack the Thunder God Fortress than try Su Hailun's methods again. This woman has been ranked with the most terrifying evil god in the legends of many polar gray dwarf tribes. And when she officially broke through the level 20 mark and was promoted to a legendary mage, Deep Blue completely turned into a peaceful land.
Even the gray dwarves, who are known for their ferocity, brutality and powerful fighting prowess, are not willing to disrupt the peace here anymore. So gradually, the surroundings of Deep Blue turned into a beautiful and prosperous land.
The above is the history of Deep Blue.
The narrator of this history is an old mage who is nearly a hundred years old. His magic power is not very strong. His level eight level is almost the most fleshly thing Richard has ever seen in Dark Blue. However, the old mage has an excellent appearance, a melodious voice, and his proficiency in the history of Deep Blue is second only to Su Hailun. His duty is simple, that is, to explain history to visitors to Deep Blue. For a new apprentice like Richard, learning about Deep Blue's glorious and glorious past is the first lesson in his magic career, and its importance is even more important than magic power and talent testing. The latter determines which path a magician can go further in the complex magical world, while the former, Richard only realized a long time later, determines whether a certain magic apprentice can embark on the path of magic.
Richard's status is different from other magic apprentices. He is a disciple recruited by Su Hailun personally, so a day of history study for ordinary apprentices has turned into three days. If you want to tell the history of Deep Blue for three days, it will indeed test the skill of the old mage.
The history told by the old mage naturally omitted many details, and also deliberately ignored many key things. However, there are always trade-offs in official history. What can be said and what can only be forgotten are all knowledge. Being able to put together a fairly complete picture in his mind, Richard has fully unleashed his talents of wisdom and truth.
Three days of brainwashing still had a significant effect. At least now when Richard sees Su Hailun again, he will never regard her as an innocent fair girl, and he will not have the urge to take a bite of her. It is hard to overstate the terror of a woman who is feared even by gray dwarves and ice giant beasts.
Of course, this result was definitely not the old mage's original intention, but he wouldn't know that. In the eyes of most people, Richard is a quiet child, so quiet that he has few unnecessary expressions. He has never been seen smiling happily, nor has he cried after being scolded or bullied. He will do whatever is asked of him immediately, and he will complete it meticulously and with impeccable precision. He is not at all like a ten-year-old child.
There was no sunshine at all on Richard.
After three days of history class, it was time for the magic talent test. Richard was taken into a special hall, Lin LiThe alchemy equipment dazzled him. There were more than twenty mages busy in the hall, and the one presiding over the test was a great magician. When Richard used his 'real' ability, what he saw was not a magician at all, but a burning magic fireball! This is a great magician of at least seventeenth level who can serve as a court mage in any empire, but he was assigned to do his talent test.
